nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Học hành & dự định · bài tự soạn
L: You're still up? It's almost midnight, Leo.
I can't sleep. My math exam is tomorrow, and I'm freaking out.
Almost. I've already finished the formulas, but I haven't done the practice tests.
Then stop panicking and do one now. If you get stuck, I'll help you.
Really? You'd do that at midnight?
Sure. I had to study for exams too, you know. Mom made me stay up until two.
Okay, deal. But if I fail, it's your fault.
Ha! You won't fail. You always do better than you think.
Thanks, sis. I'm gonna grab my notes.

exq.a: He is worried about a math exam
exq.why: “My math exam is tomorrow, and I'm freaking out.” = mai thi toán và đang hoảng.

exq.q: What has Leo not done yet?
exq.why: “I haven't done the practice tests.” = chưa làm đề luyện tập.

exq.q: What does Mia offer to do?
exq.a: Help Leo if he gets stuck
exq.why: “If you get stuck, I'll help you.” = nếu em bí, chị sẽ giúp.

exq.q: What does Mia say about herself?
exq.a: She also had to study late for exams
exq.why: “I had to study for exams too … until two.” = chị cũng từng phải thức khuya ôn thi.
